error_team_evidence: Deliverable must be reachable over public HTTPS, with matching ETag and Last-Modified after work started. Missing metadata cannot pass.
error_team_incomplete: Complete every checklist item with evidence and resolve all registered risks before sign-off.
error_team_status: The draft status differs from current Delivery work. Correct it before adoption.
error_provider_adapter: The requested provider adapter is not installed
error_provider_license: A Human must accept the current licence and regional notices
error_provider_binding: A provider with the matching kind and actual healthy state is required
error_calibration_samples: Insufficient independent Human labelled samples for calibration
error_calibration_pending: Actual calibration evaluation has not completed
error_calibration_target: Calibration agreement is below the frozen acceptance target
error_key_taken: A template with this key already exists
error_no_newer_version: Publish a higher version of this template before deprecating this version
error_mandatory_gate: Inherited mandatory Human gates must be retained
error_override_out_of_range: The parameter cannot be overridden or is outside the published range
error_breaking_unacknowledged: A Human must acknowledge the breaking major version change
error_diff_mismatch: Versions must belong to the same template
studio_notice: Studio records describe human source material; automated generation and QC are unavailable.
